svg.title: Grass-blade cactus plant portrait
svg.desc: Photo-informed schematic of a low green Grass-blade cactus with many thin wavy ribs, white crown tufts and sparse long brown-and-cream spines, in mixed mineral top dressing and a teal-blue faceted pot.
